result.reasoning: 根据文档结构和内容复杂度，将需求分析拆分为4个analyze任务，分别覆盖案件管理核心流程、系统辅助功能、非功能性需求和架构建议。设计、图表和测试任务各1个。

tasks.description: 分析案件管理核心流程（注册、调查、起诉、搜索）

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供所有用户界面上所有可能操作和场景的详细上下文敏感帮助材料
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供用户界面用于记录应用程序的缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在用户选择时发送警报（如电子邮件、短信）当对警报采取任何行动时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word “unalterable” is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

availableConstraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须自动跟踪事件并存储相关信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许将访问限制于特定用户或用户组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

availableConstraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中不得包含用户无权访问的任何记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够同时显示多个实体（案件、嫌疑人）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

availableConstraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置，配置必须保存在用户配置文件中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内检索并显示最近2个月内访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须支持多语言界面
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multilingual interface

availableConstraints.description: 系统设计应确保在设备或通信网络故障时不会丢失操作数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持选择性加密存储数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

availableConstraints.description: 系统应确保通过网络安全传输数据，使用SSL和双向数字签名
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止跨站脚本攻击
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent cross-site scripting

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止SQL注入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent SQL Injection

availableConstraints.description: 系统不应允许硬删除，只应执行软标记删除行
availableConstraints.sourceText: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁访问的数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of cache for storing frequent data

availableConstraints.description: 搜索结果应从数据库中以最多10或20条为一批获取
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

availableConstraints.description: 搜索应仅获取需要显示给用户的字段
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

availableConstraints.description: 应在用于搜索的关键列上应用数据库索引
availableConstraints.sourceText: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够导出指定案件的审计跟踪
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够捕获和存储访问控制机制的违规行为
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user’s attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够按案件、用户和时间顺序提供案件操作报告
availableConstraints.sourceText: By case; By user; In chronological sequence. The System must at a minimum be able to provide reports for actions on cases organised:

availableConstraints.description: 系统应能够按工作站和网络地址提供案件操作报告
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System should be able to provide reports for actions on cases organised by workstation and (where technically appropriate) by network address.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供角色基于功能的控制
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户属于多个组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应允许用户指定哪些其他用户或组可以访问案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System should allow a user to stipulate which other users or groups can access cases.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须对无权访问的案件请求提供可配置的响应
availableConstraints.sourceText: display title and metadata; display the existence of a case but not its title or other metadata; do not display any case information or indicate its existence in any way. If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. Note that the requirement in the third option (i.e. the most stringent) implies that the System must not include such cases in any count of search results; this level of security is normally appropriate for cases dealing with matters such as national security.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须将未经授权的案件访问尝试记录到审计跟踪中
availableConstraints.sourceText: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须将所有案件访问和相关活动存储在审计跟踪中
availableConstraints.sourceText: Any access to cases, and all other activities involving the cases and related documents or data should also need to be stored in the audit trail to ensure legal admissibility and to assist in data recovery.

availableConstraints.description: 系统产生的所有错误消息必须是有意义的
availableConstraints.sourceText: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须采用单一的用户界面规则集
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供易于使用和直观的终端用户和管理员功能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must provide End User and Administrator functions which are easy to use and intuitive throughout.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许数据输入的可持久默认值
availableConstraints.sourceText: user-definable values; values same as previous item; values derived from context, e.g. date, file reference, user identifier; The System must allow persistent defaults for data entry where desirable. These defaults should include:

availableConstraints.description: 频繁执行的系统事务必须设计为可以用少量交互完成
availableConstraints.sourceText: Frequently-executed System transactions must be designed so that they can be completed with a small number of interactions (e.g. mouse clicks).

availableConstraints.description: 图形用户界面必须允许用户自定义
availableConstraints.sourceText: menu contents; layout of screens; use of function keys; on-screen colours, fonts and font sizes; Where the System employs a graphical user interface, it must allow users to customise it. Customisation should include, but need not be limited to the following changes:

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为用户直观的
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces should be designed to make them user-intuitive.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面应符合ISO 9241标准
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持离线模式下的关键功能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should work even in an offline mode with the critical functionality

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为在低带宽连接的警察局也能有满意的性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用服务导向架构(SOA)和模块化设计实现
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

availableConstraints.description: 系统应建立在开放标准上开发
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed on Open Standards

availableConstraints.description: 系统应建立在通用用户访问和认证服务上，确保终端用户单点登录
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为集中部署和维护
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance

availableConstraints.description: 系统应开发为部署在三层数据中心架构中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为n层架构，表示逻辑与业务逻辑分离，业务逻辑与数据访问逻辑分离
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic

availableConstraints.description: 系统应可扩展以通过PDA和移动数据终端提供接口访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA’s and mobile data terminals

availableConstraints.description: 系统应采用标准化格式和通用元数据元素
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为通过基于浏览器的系统访问，并对客户端设备要求最低
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须支持多种类型的远程访问通信服务
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

availableConstraints.description: 系统应具备支持公共访问部分数据和功能的能力
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持多级认证
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持SSL加密连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持安全虚拟专用网络连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在多个浏览器上运行
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should run on multiple browsers

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供检查
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须可扩展，不得有任何阻止在小或大型警察局使用的特性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供在标准和峰值条件下常用功能的适当响应时间
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须验证传入数据/用户请求
availableConstraints.sourceText: Validate the incoming data / user request

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须编码传入数据/用户请求
availableConstraints.sourceText: Encode the incoming data / user request

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用参数化查询
availableConstraints.sourceText: Utilize parameterized queries

availableConstraints.description: 系统应清理用户输入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Sanitize the user-inputs

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在客户端和服务器端验证数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: Validate the data both at the client and server

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用AJAX技术改善用户体验
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应考虑基于屏幕和估计使用模式的积极页面加载
availableConstraints.sourceText: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

availableConstraints.description: 系统应利用Web服务器的异步HTTP套接字功能实现可扩展性和性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在Web服务器上托管所有静态内容
availableConstraints.sourceText: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

availableConstraints.description: 系统应以分页/分批方式在屏幕上显示记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

availableConstraints.description: 系统应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
availableConstraints.sourceText: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供不熟悉系统的授权外部人员访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户跟踪提交的缺陷或增强请求
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须使帮助台用户能够查看按类别、状态和年龄分类的缺陷或增强请求报告

availableConstraints.sourceText: The support solution should be accessible to the users both from within the application and also outside the application through a browser interface.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户属于多个组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应允许用户指定哪些其他用户或组可以访问案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System should allow a user to stipulate which other users or groups can access cases.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须对无权访问的案件请求提供可配置的响应
availableConstraints.sourceText: display title and metadata; display the existence of a case but not its title or other metadata; do not display any case information or indicate its existence in any way. If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. Note that the requirement in the third option (i.e. the most stringent) implies that the System must not include such cases in any count of search results; this level of security is normally appropriate for cases dealing with matters such as national security.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须将未经授权的案件访问尝试记录到审计跟踪中
availableConstraints.sourceText: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须将所有案件访问和相关活动存储在审计跟踪中
availableConstraints.sourceText: Any access to cases, and all other activities involving the cases and related documents or data should also need to be stored in the audit trail to ensure legal admissibility and to assist in data recovery.

availableConstraints.description: 系统产生的所有错误消息必须是有意义的
availableConstraints.sourceText: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须采用单一的用户界面规则集
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供易于使用和直观的终端用户和管理员功能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must provide End User and Administrator functions which are easy to use and intuitive throughout.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许数据输入的可持久默认值
availableConstraints.sourceText: user-definable values; values same as previous item; values derived from context, e.g. date, file reference, user identifier; The System must allow persistent defaults for data entry where desirable. These defaults should include:

availableConstraints.description: 频繁执行的系统事务必须设计为可以用少量交互完成
availableConstraints.sourceText: Frequently-executed System transactions must be designed so that they can be completed with a small number of interactions (e.g. mouse clicks).

availableConstraints.description: 图形用户界面必须允许用户自定义
availableConstraints.sourceText: menu contents; layout of screens; use of function keys; on-screen colours, fonts and font sizes; Where the System employs a graphical user interface, it must allow users to customise it. Customisation should include, but need not be limited to the following changes:

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为用户直观的
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces should be designed to make them user-intuitive.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面应符合ISO 9241标准
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持离线模式下的关键功能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should work even in an offline mode with the critical functionality

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为在低带宽连接的警察局也能有满意的性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用服务导向架构(SOA)和模块化设计实现
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

availableConstraints.description: 系统应建立在开放标准上开发
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed on Open Standards

availableConstraints.description: 系统应建立在通用用户访问和认证服务上，确保终端用户单点登录
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为集中部署和维护
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance

availableConstraints.description: 系统应开发为部署在三层数据中心架构中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为n层架构，表示逻辑与业务逻辑分离，业务逻辑与数据访问逻辑分离
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic

availableConstraints.description: 系统应可扩展以通过PDA和移动数据终端提供接口访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA’s and mobile data terminals

availableConstraints.description: 系统应采用标准化格式和通用元数据元素
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为通过基于浏览器的系统访问，并对客户端设备要求最低
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须支持多种类型的远程访问通信服务
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

availableConstraints.description: 系统应具备支持公共访问部分数据和功能的能力
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持多级认证
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持SSL加密连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持安全虚拟专用网络连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在多个浏览器上运行
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should run on multiple browsers

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供检查
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须可扩展，不得有任何阻止在小或大型警察局使用的特性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供在标准和峰值条件下常用功能的适当响应时间
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须验证传入数据/用户请求
availableConstraints.sourceText: Validate the incoming data / user request

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须编码传入数据/用户请求
availableConstraints.sourceText: Encode the incoming data / user request

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用参数化查询
availableConstraints.sourceText: Utilize parameterized queries

availableConstraints.description: 系统应清理用户输入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Sanitize the user-inputs

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在客户端和服务器端验证数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: Validate the data both at the client and server

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用AJAX技术改善用户体验
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应考虑基于屏幕和估计使用模式的积极页面加载
availableConstraints.sourceText: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

availableConstraints.description: 系统应利用Web服务器的异步HTTP套接字功能实现可扩展性和性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在Web服务器上托管所有静态内容
availableConstraints.sourceText: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

availableConstraints.description: 系统应以分页/分批方式在屏幕上显示记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

availableConstraints.description: 系统应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
availableConstraints.sourceText: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供不熟悉系统的授权外部人员访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户跟踪提交的缺陷或增强请求
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须使帮助台用户能够查看按类别、状态和年龄分类的缺陷或增强请求报告
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should enable the help-desk user to view the reports on the submitted defects or enhancement requests category-wise, status-wise, and age- wise.

availableConstraints.description: 支持解决方案必须可从应用程序内部和外部通过浏览器界面访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The support solution should be accessible to the users both from within the application and also outside the application through a browser interface.

tasks.description: 分析非功能性需求（可用性、性能、安全性）

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供所有用户界面上所有可能操作和场景的详细上下文敏感帮助材料
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供用户界面用于记录应用程序的缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在用户选择时发送警报（如电子邮件、短信）当对警报采取任何行动时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word “unalterable” is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

availableConstraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须自动跟踪事件并存储相关信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许将访问限制于特定用户或用户组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

availableConstraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中不得包含用户无权访问的任何记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够同时显示多个实体（案件、嫌疑人）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

availableConstraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置，配置必须保存在用户配置文件中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内检索并显示最近2个月内访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须支持多语言界面
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multilingual interface

availableConstraints.description: 系统设计应确保在设备或通信网络故障时不会丢失操作数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持选择性加密存储数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

availableConstraints.description: 系统应确保通过网络安全传输数据，使用SSL和双向数字签名
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止跨站脚本攻击
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent cross-site scripting

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止SQL注入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent SQL Injection

availableConstraints.description: 系统不应允许硬删除，只应执行软标记删除行
availableConstraints.sourceText: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁访问的数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of cache for storing frequent data

availableConstraints.description: 搜索结果应从数据库中以最多10或20条为一批获取
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

availableConstraints.description: 搜索应仅获取需要显示给用户的字段
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

availableConstraints.description: 应在用于搜索的关键列上应用数据库索引

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够导出指定案件的审计跟踪

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用AJAX技术改善用户体验
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应考虑基于屏幕和估计使用模式的积极页面加载
availableConstraints.sourceText: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

availableConstraints.description: 系统应利用Web服务器的异步HTTP套接字功能实现可扩展性和性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在Web服务器上托管所有静态内容

availableConstraints.description: 系统应以分页/分批方式在屏幕上显示记录

availableConstraints.description: 系统应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
availableConstraints.sourceText: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供不熟悉系统的授权外部人员访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户跟踪提交的缺陷或增强请求
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须使帮助台用户能够查看按类别、状态和年龄分类的缺陷或增强请求报告
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should enable the help-desk user to view the reports on the submitted defects or enhancement requests category-wise, status-wise, and age- wise.

availableConstraints.description: 支持解决方案必须可从应用程序内部和外部通过浏览器界面访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The support solution should be accessible to the users both from within the application and also outside the application through a browser interface.

tasks.description: 分析架构建议和技术约束

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供所有用户界面上所有可能操作和场景的详细上下文敏感帮助材料
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供用户界面用于记录应用程序的缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在用户选择时发送警报（如电子邮件、短信）当对警报采取任何行动时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word “unalterable” is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

availableConstraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须自动跟踪事件并存储相关信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许将访问限制于特定用户或用户组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

availableConstraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中不得包含用户无权访问的任何记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够同时显示多个实体（案件、嫌疑人）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

availableConstraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置，配置必须保存在用户配置文件中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内检索并显示最近2个月内访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须支持多语言界面
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multilingual interface

availableConstraints.description: 系统设计应确保在设备或通信网络故障时不会丢失操作数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持选择性加密存储数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

availableConstraints.description: 系统应确保通过网络安全传输数据，使用SSL和双向数字签名
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止跨站脚本攻击
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent cross-site scripting

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止SQL注入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent SQL Injection

availableConstraints.description: 系统不应允许硬删除，只应执行软标记删除行
availableConstraints.sourceText: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁访问的数据

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够捕获和存储访问控制机制的违规行为
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user’s attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够按案件、用户和时间顺序提供案件操作报告
availableConstraints.sourceText: By case; By user; In chronological sequence. The System must at a minimum be able to provide reports for actions on cases organised:

availableConstraints.sourceText: The System should be able to provide reports for actions on cases organised by workstation and (where technically appropriate) by network address.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供角色基于功能的控制

availableConstraints.description: 系统应允许用户指定哪些其他用户或组可以访问案件

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须对无权访问的案件请求提供可配置的响应
availableConstraints.sourceText: display title and metadata; display the existence of a case but not its title or other metadata; do not display any case information or indicate its existence in any way. If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. contextHints.previous_artifact_content:
## 系统设计方案

### 1. 系统概述
警务案件管理系统是一个用于案件注册、调查、起诉和搜索的综合平台，旨在提高警务工作效率和信息安全性。系统支持多角色协作，包括警务人员、管理员、公民和外部审计人员，提供完整的案件生命周期管理和审计跟踪功能。

### 2. 系统分层架构
采用三层架构设计，符合C049约束要求：

1. **表现层**：
   - 负责用户界面展示和交互
   - 实现GUI自定义功能(F001)
   - 处理用户输入验证(C057,C058)
   - 实现导航菜单权限控制(C004)
   - 支持多语言切换(C068)

2. **业务层**：
   - 核心业务逻辑处理
   - 案件管理、权限控制、审计跟踪等核心功能
   - 实现业务规则校验(C001-C083)
   - 处理数据加密和解密(C005)
   - 执行敏感操作日志记录(C006)
   - 验证用户会话有效性(C007)
   - 实施操作频率限制(C008)
   - 管理数据保留策略(C009)
   - 处理并发控制(C012)
   - 验证数据完整性(C013)
   - 执行输入过滤(C014)
   - 验证输出编码(C015)
   - 管理会话超时(C016)
   - 验证证书有效性(C017)
   - 执行密码策略(C018)
   - 验证多因素认证(C019)
   - 管理审计日志保留(C020)
   - 验证文件上传(C022)
   - 执行安全头设置(C024)
   - 验证CSRF令牌(C025)
   - 管理安全配置(C026)
   - 验证API签名(C028)
   - 执行数据脱敏(C031)
   - 验证地理位置(C034)
   - 管理设备指纹(C035)
   - 验证生物特征(C036)
   - 执行风险评估(C038)
   - 验证威胁情报(C039)
   - 管理安全警报(C040)
   - 验证备份完整性(C041)
   - 执行恢复测试(C042)
   - 验证灾难恢复(C043)
   - 管理补丁级别(C044)
   - 验证漏洞扫描(C046)
   - 执行渗透测试(C047)
   - 管理安全培训(C050)
   - 验证合规状态(C054)
   - 执行隐私评估(C055)
   - 验证数据主权(C056)
   - 管理第三方访问(C060)
   - 验证供应链安全(C061)
   - 执行云安全配置(C062)
   - 验证容器安全(C063)
   - 管理密钥轮换(C064)
   - 验证证书撤销(C065)
   - 执行安全监控(C069)
   - 验证事件响应(C070)
   - 管理取证数据(C073)
   - 验证法律保留(C074)
   - 执行电子发现(C075)
   - 管理调查工作流(C076)
   - 验证证据链(C077)
   - 执行安全审计(C079)
   - 验证配置基线(C081)

3. **数据层**：
   - 数据持久化和检索
   - 支持多级缓存(C051,C052)
   - 实现审计数据不可更改(C080)

不采用微服务架构，因为需求分析中未明确要求分布式部署(C003)，且系统规模适合单体架构。

### 3. 模块划分

| 模块名称 | 职责描述 | 对应功能 |
|----------|----------|----------|
| 案件管理模块 | 处理案件注册、调查、起诉全生命周期 | F003, F006, F007 |
| 搜索模块 | 提供案件快速检索和高级搜索功能 | F008 |
| 权限控制模块 | 管理用户访问权限和组配置 | F004 |
| 审计模块 | 记录系统活动并支持审计数据导出 | F002 |
| 系统配置模块 | 管理系统参数和用户界面设置 | F001, F005 |
| 缺陷跟踪模块 | 处理缺陷报告和状态跟踪 | F009 |
| 报表模块 | 生成各类系统报告 | F010 |
| 导航模块 | 管理菜单和页面导航权限 | - |
| 安全模块 | 实现所有安全相关约束 | - |

### 4. 核心类/接口设计

| 类名 | 职责 | 关键属性 | 关键方法 | 关联实体 |
|------|------|----------|----------|----------|
| Case | 案件核心实体 | caseId, title, status, createdAt | register(), investigate(), prosecute() | Suspect, Property, AuditTrail |
| Suspect | 嫌疑人信息 | suspectId, name, status | addToCase(), updateStatus() | Case |
| Property | 案件相关财产/证据 | propertyId, name, status | markAsEvidence(), release() | Case |
| AuditTrail | 审计记录 | auditId, action, timestamp | logEvent(), exportData() | Case |
| UserProfile | 用户配置 | profileId, uiConfig, defaults | savePreferences(), resetDefaults() | AccessControl |
| AccessControl | 权限控制 | controlId, securityLevel | checkPermission(), updateSecurityAttributes() | UserProfile |
| Defect | 缺陷报告 | defectId, status, category | submit(), updateStatus() | UserProfile |
| Configuration | 系统配置 | configId, name, value | updateSetting(), rollbackChange() | - |
| Navigation | 导航菜单管理 | menuId, items, permissions | getAuthorizedMenus(), validateAccess() | AccessControl |
| SecurityManager | 安全管理 | - | encryptData(), validateSession(), applySecurityHeaders() | - |

### 5. 数据流说明

1. **案件注册流程**：
   - 公民或警务人员提交案件信息(F007)
   - 系统生成唯一案件ID并创建审计记录(C082)
   - 案件状态初始化为"新案件"
   - 执行敏感数据加密(C005)
   - 记录操作日志(C006)

2. **案件调查流程**：
   - 警务人员访问案件(F003)
   - 系统校验访问权限(C071)
   - 验证会话有效性(C007)
   - 添加嫌疑人、证据等关联信息
   - 更新案件状态和审计记录

3. **案件搜索流程**：
   - 用户输入搜索条件(F008)
   - 系统应用权限过滤(C071)
   - 执行输入验证(C014)
   - 从缓存或数据库检索数据(C052)
   - 返回分页结果(C021)
   - 应用输出编码(C015)

4. **审计数据导出**：
   - 审计人员选择导出范围(F002)
   - 系统生成标准化报告(C078)
   - 记录导出操作到审计日志(C080)
   - 验证CSRF令牌(C025)

### 6. 接口设计

1. **案件服务接口**：
   - registerCase(): 处理新案件注册(F007)
   - getCaseDetails(): 获取案件详情(F003)
   - updateCaseStatus(): 更新案件状态(F006)

2. **搜索服务接口**：
   - basicSearch(): 简单搜索(F008)
   - advancedSearch(): 高级搜索(F008)

3. **审计服务接口**：
   - exportAuditTrail(): 导出审计数据(F002)
   - logAccessViolation(): 记录权限违规(C066)

4. **安全服务接口**：
   - validateSecurityToken(): 验证安全令牌(C025)
   - encryptSensitiveData(): 加密敏感数据(C005)
   - checkAccessFrequency(): 检查访问频率(C008)

### 7. 约束与异常处理设计

**关键约束实现**：
- C001-C002: 通过多级存储策略实现，近期案件存内存，历史案件存磁盘
- C004: 导航菜单根据用户权限动态生成
- C005: 敏感数据使用AES-256加密存储
- C006: 所有敏感操作记录到不可更改的审计日志
- C007: 会话有效性通过JWT令牌验证
- C008: 操作频率限制使用令牌桶算法
- C009: 数据保留策略按案件类型和状态配置
- C010: 在案件ID、状态等字段创建数据库索引
- C012: 使用乐观锁处理并发修改
- C013: 数据完整性通过哈希校验
- C014: 所有输入经过白名单过滤
- C015: 输出数据应用HTML/URL编码
- C016: 会话超时15分钟无活动自动注销
- C017: 证书有效性通过OCSP验证
- C018: 密码策略强制12字符+特殊字符
- C019: 关键操作需要MFA验证
- C020: 审计日志保留7年
- C022: 文件上传限制类型和大小
- C023: 权限变更需超级用户权限，前端隐藏相关界面
- C024: 设置CSP、HSTS等安全头
- C025: CSRF令牌验证所有表单提交
- C026: 安全配置集中管理
- C028: API请求需要数字签名
- C031: 敏感数据显示时脱敏
- C034: 地理位置用于风险评估
- C035: 设备指纹用于异常检测
- C036: 生物特征用于高权限操作
- C038: 风险评估引擎监控异常行为
- C039: 集成威胁情报服务
- C040: 安全警报实时通知
- C041: 备份完整性定期校验
- C042: 恢复测试每季度执行
- C043: 灾难恢复计划文档化
- C044: 补丁级别自动报告
- C045: 搜索服务实现超时控制，简单查询优先使用缓存
- C046: 漏洞扫描每月执行
- C047: 渗透测试每年执行
- C048: 基于角色的访问控制实现
- C050: 安全培训每半年强制
- C051-C052: 实现分层缓存策略
- C053: 全站HTTPS强制
- C054: 合规状态仪表盘
- C055: 隐私影响评估工具
- C056: 数据主权规则引擎
- C057-C058: 输入验证前端+后端
- C059: 实现可配置的无权访问响应策略
- C060: 第三方访问受控
- C061: 供应链安全验证
- C062: 云安全配置扫描
- C063: 容器安全扫描
- C064: 密钥每90天轮换
- C065: 证书撤销列表检查
- C066: 访问违规记录
- C067-C072: 响应式无障碍设计
- C069: 安全监控7×24
- C070: 事件响应演练

- C073: 取证数据保护

- C081: 配置基线检查

**异常处理**：
- X001: 返回"案件不存在"错误，记录到审计日志
- X002: 提示"审计功能未激活"，引导用户联系管理员
- X003: 终止搜索，返回"操作超时"提示
- X004: 重定向到登录页面，保存原始请求URL
- X005: 根据配置返回不同级别的响应
- X006: 记录加密失败，返回安全错误
- X007: 记录会话验证失败，强制注销
- X008: 阻止高频操作，临时锁定
- X009: 阻止提交，高亮缺失的证据字段
- X010: 记录无效安全头尝试
- X011: 阻止CSRF攻击，记录IP
- X012: 阻止配置篡改，告警管理员
- X013: 拒绝无效签名API请求
- X014: 阻止地理位置欺骗
- X015: 检测设备变更，要求验证
- X016: 生物特征失败转MFA
- X017-X019: 记录违规尝试，返回配置的响应
- X018: 阻止威胁情报匹配操作
- X020: 隔离受损账户

### 8. 非功能需求设计

1. **性能**：
   - 实现分层缓存(C051,C052)
   - 搜索分页加载(C021)
   - 异步处理耗时操作(C027)

2. **安全**：
   - 全站HTTPS(C053)
   - 输入验证和防注入(C032,C033,C037)
   - 基于角色的访问控制(C048)

3. **可用性**：
   - 响应式设计支持多设备(C067,C072)

4. **可靠性**：
   - 审计数据不可更改(C080)

   - 数据备份和恢复机制(C029)

5. **Help模块设计**：

   - 通知机制支持多种渠道

        已判决 --> [*]

constraints.description: Provide context-sensitive help for all UI actions
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: Interface for logging/tracking defects
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: Maintain unalterable audit trail
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word "unalterable" is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Restrict case access to specified users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Save UI customizations in user profile
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

constraints.description: UI compatible with special needs software
constraints.source_text: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

constraints.description: Export case audit trails
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

constraints.description: Log access control violations
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user's attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

constraints.description: Implement role-based functionality control
constraints.source_text: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

constraints.description: Allow tracking submitted defects
constraints.source_text: The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

exceptions.trigger: User tries to access restricted case
exceptions.handling: Log violation and show configured response
Notify administrator and preserve original audit data

exceptions.trigger: Required fields missing in defect report
exceptions.handling: Show meaningful error message with guidance

HTTPS protocol with SSL encryption for all communications
UI complies with ISO 9241 accessibility standards
Critical functionality available in offline mode
Supports deployment in police stations of varying sizes

constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: UI must be customizable
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

constraints.description: Fast search performance requirements
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

constraints.description: Use HTTPS for communication

constraints.source_text: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

constraints.source_text: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

constraints.description: Apply database indexes on search columns
constraints.source_text: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

constraints.description: Export audit trails for specified cases
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

constraints.description: Provide role-based control
constraints.source_text: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

constraints.description: Allow users in multiple groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

constraints.description: Allow users to specify access rights
constraints.source_text: The System should allow a user to stipulate which other users or groups can access cases.

constraints.description: Provide meaningful error messages
constraints.source_text: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

constraints.description: Use consistent UI rules
constraints.source_text: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

constraints.description: Provide intuitive user functions
constraints.source_text: The System must provide End User and Administrator functions which are easy to use and intuitive throughout.

constraints.source_text: Frequently-executed System transactions must be designed so that they can be completed with a small number of interactions (e.g. mouse clicks).

constraints.description: Design intuitive user interfaces
constraints.source_text: The user interfaces should be designed to make them user-intuitive.

constraints.description: Comply with ISO 9241 standards
constraints.source_text: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

constraints.description: Support offline mode for critical functions
constraints.source_text: The system should work even in an offline mode with the critical functionality

constraints.description: Support low-bandwidth performance
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

constraints.description: Use SOA and modular design

constraints.description: Develop on open standards

constraints.description: Support single sign-on

constraints.description: Design for centralized deployment
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance

constraints.description: Deploy in 3-tier architecture
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

constraints.description: Use n-tier architecture with separation of concerns
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic

constraints.description: Support access via mobile devices
constraints.source_text: The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA's and mobile data terminals

constraints.description: Use standardized formats and metadata
constraints.source_text: The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

constraints.description: Support browser-based access with minimal client requirements
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

constraints.description: Support multiple remote access types
constraints.source_text: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

constraints.description: Support public access to subset of data
constraints.source_text: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality

constraints.description: Support multi-tier authentication
constraints.source_text: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

constraints.description: Support SSL encrypted connections

constraints.description: Support secure VPN connections
constraints.source_text: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

constraints.description: Run on multiple browsers
constraints.source_text: The system should run on multiple browsers

constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

constraints.description: Ensure system scalability
constraints.source_text: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

constraints.description: Provide adequate response times
constraints.source_text: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

constraints.description: Validate incoming data
constraints.source_text: Validate the incoming data / user request

constraints.description: Encode incoming data
constraints.source_text: Encode the incoming data / user request

constraints.source_text: Utilize parameterized queries

constraints.description: Sanitize user inputs
constraints.source_text: Sanitize the user-inputs

constraints.description: Validate data at client and server
constraints.source_text: Validate the data both at the client and server

constraints.description: Use AJAX to improve UX
constraints.source_text: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

constraints.description: Consider aggressive page loading
constraints.source_text: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

constraints.description: Leverage asynchronous HTTP sockets
constraints.source_text: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

constraints.description: Host static content on web server
constraints.source_text: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

constraints.description: Display records in batches/pages
constraints.source_text: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

constraints.description: Use hierarchical cache for frequent searches
constraints.source_text: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

constraints.description: Ensure audit trail accessible to external personnel
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

constraints.description: Allow tracking of defect/enhancement requests
constraints.source_text: The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

constraints.description: Provide defect/enhancement reports
constraints.source_text: The solution should enable the help-desk user to view the reports on the submitted defects or enhancement requests category-wise, status-wise, and age- wise.

constraints.description: Support solution accessible inside/outside application
constraints.source_text: The support solution should be accessible to the users both from within the application and also outside the application through a browser interface.

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access case without permission
exceptions.handling: Log attempt in audit trail and show configured response

exceptions.trigger: Search takes longer than allowed time
exceptions.handling: Show timeout message and suggest refining search

constraints.description: 系统必须提供所有用户界面上所有可能操作和场景的详细上下文敏感帮助材料
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: 系统必须提供用户界面用于记录应用程序的缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: 系统必须在用户选择时发送警报（如电子邮件、短信）当对警报采取任何行动时
constraints.source_text: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

constraints.description: 系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word “unalterable” is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须自动跟踪事件并存储相关信息
constraints.source_text: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
constraints.source_text: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

constraints.description: 系统必须允许将访问限制于特定用户或用户组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
constraints.source_text: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

constraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中不得包含用户无权访问的任何记录

constraints.source_text: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

constraints.description: 系统必须提供在标准和峰值条件下常用功能的适当响应时间
constraints.source_text: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

constraints.description: 系统必须在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

constraints.description: 系统必须验证传入数据/用户请求
constraints.source_text: Validate the incoming data / user request

constraints.description: 系统必须编码传入数据/用户请求
constraints.source_text: Encode the incoming data / user request

constraints.description: 系统应使用参数化查询
constraints.source_text: Utilize parameterized queries

constraints.description: 系统应清理用户输入
constraints.source_text: Sanitize the user-inputs

constraints.description: 系统应在客户端和服务器端验证数据
constraints.source_text: Validate the data both at the client and server

constraints.description: 系统应使用AJAX技术改善用户体验
constraints.source_text: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

constraints.description: 系统应考虑基于屏幕和估计使用模式的积极页面加载
constraints.source_text: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

constraints.description: 系统应利用Web服务器的异步HTTP套接字功能实现可扩展性和性能
constraints.source_text: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

constraints.description: 系统应在Web服务器上托管所有静态内容
constraints.source_text: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

constraints.description: 系统应以分页/分批方式在屏幕上显示记录
constraints.source_text: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

constraints.description: 系统应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
constraints.source_text: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

constraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供不熟悉系统的授权外部人员访问
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

constraints.description: 系统必须允许用户跟踪提交的缺陷或增强请求
constraints.source_text: The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

constraints.description: 系统必须使帮助台用户能够查看按类别、状态和年龄分类的缺陷或增强请求报告
constraints.source_text: The solution should enable the help-desk user to view the reports on the submitted defects or enhancement requests category-wise, status-wise, and age- wise.

constraints.description: 支持解决方案必须可从应用程序内部和外部通过浏览器界面访问
constraints.source_text: The support solution should be accessible to the users both from within the application and also outside the application through a browser interface.

exceptions.trigger: 用户尝试访问没有权限的案件
exceptions.handling: 根据配置显示不同级别的响应（显示标题和元数据/仅显示存在/完全不显示）

exceptions.trigger: 搜索操作超过规定时间
exceptions.handling: 终止搜索并显示超时错误

exceptions.trigger: 尝试访问不存在的案件
exceptions.handling: 显示错误消息并记录到审计跟踪

exceptions.trigger: 尝试执行需要登录的操作

non_functional_requirements.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
系统必须在5-8秒内检索并显示最近2个月内访问过的案件
系统必须在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪

系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
系统必须提供易于使用和直观的终端用户和管理员功能
系统必须可扩展，不得有任何阻止在小或大型警察局使用的特性
系统应使用服务导向架构(SOA)和模块化设计实现

result.content:
## 系统设计方案

### 1. 系统概述
警务案件管理系统是一个用于案件注册、调查、起诉和搜索的综合平台，旨在提高警务工作效率和信息安全性。系统支持多角色协作，包括警务人员、管理员、公民和外部审计人员，提供完整的案件生命周期管理和审计跟踪功能。

### 2. 系统分层架构
采用三层架构设计，符合C049约束要求：

1. **表现层**：
   - 负责用户界面展示和交互
   - 实现GUI自定义功能(F001)
   - 处理用户输入验证(C057,C058)

2. **业务层**：
   - 核心业务逻辑处理
   - 案件管理、权限控制、审计跟踪等核心功能
   - 实现业务规则校验(C001-C083)

3. **数据层**：
   - 数据持久化和检索
   - 支持多级缓存(C051,C052)
   - 实现审计数据不可更改(C080)

不采用微服务架构，因为需求分析中未明确要求分布式部署(C003)，且系统规模适合单体架构。

### 3. 模块划分

| 模块名称 | 职责描述 | 对应功能 |
|----------|----------|----------|
| 案件管理模块 | 处理案件注册、调查、起诉全生命周期 | F003, F006, F007 |
| 搜索模块 | 提供案件快速检索和高级搜索功能 | F008 |
| 权限控制模块 | 管理用户访问权限和组配置 | F004 |
| 审计模块 | 记录系统活动并支持审计数据导出 | F002 |
| 系统配置模块 | 管理系统参数和用户界面设置 | F001, F005 |
| 缺陷跟踪模块 | 处理缺陷报告和状态跟踪 | F009 |
| 报表模块 | 生成各类系统报告 | F010 |

### 4. 核心类/接口设计

| 类名 | 职责 | 关键属性 | 关键方法 | 关联实体 |
|------|------|----------|----------|----------|
| Case | 案件核心实体 | caseId, title, status, createdAt | register(), investigate(), prosecute() | Suspect, Property, AuditTrail |
| Suspect | 嫌疑人信息 | suspectId, name, status | addToCase(), updateStatus() | Case |
| Property | 案件相关财产/证据 | propertyId, name, status | markAsEvidence(), release() | Case |
| AuditTrail | 审计记录 | auditId, action, timestamp | logEvent(), exportData() | Case |
| UserProfile | 用户配置 | profileId, uiConfig, defaults | savePreferences(), resetDefaults() | AccessControl |
| AccessControl | 权限控制 | controlId, securityLevel | checkPermission(), updateSecurityAttributes() | UserProfile |
| Defect | 缺陷报告 | defectId, status, category | submit(), updateStatus() | UserProfile |
| Configuration | 系统配置 | configId, name, value | updateSetting(), rollbackChange() | - |

### 5. 数据流说明

1. **案件注册流程**：
   - 公民或警务人员提交案件信息(F007)
   - 系统生成唯一案件ID并创建审计记录(C082)
   - 案件状态初始化为"新案件"

2. **案件调查流程**：
   - 警务人员访问案件(F003)
   - 系统校验访问权限(C071)
   - 添加嫌疑人、证据等关联信息
   - 更新案件状态和审计记录

3. **案件搜索流程**：
   - 用户输入搜索条件(F008)
   - 系统应用权限过滤(C071)
   - 从缓存或数据库检索数据(C052)
   - 返回分页结果(C021)

4. **审计数据导出**：
   - 审计人员选择导出范围(F002)
   - 系统生成标准化报告(C078)
   - 记录导出操作到审计日志(C080)

### 6. 接口设计

1. **案件服务接口**：
   - registerCase(): 处理新案件注册(F007)
   - getCaseDetails(): 获取案件详情(F003)
   - updateCaseStatus(): 更新案件状态(F006)

2. **搜索服务接口**：
   - basicSearch(): 简单搜索(F008)
   - advancedSearch(): 高级搜索(F008)

3. **审计服务接口**：
   - exportAuditTrail(): 导出审计数据(F002)
   - logAccessViolation(): 记录权限违规(C066)

### 7. 约束与异常处理设计

**关键约束实现**：
- C001-C002: 通过多级存储策略实现，近期案件存内存，历史案件存磁盘
- C010: 在案件ID、状态等字段创建数据库索引
- C023: 权限变更需超级用户权限，前端隐藏相关界面
- C045: 搜索服务实现超时控制，简单查询优先使用缓存
- C059: 实现可配置的无权访问响应策略
- C071: 搜索前先过滤无权访问的案件
- C080: 审计记录使用只读存储，修改操作记录为新条目

**异常处理**：
- X001: 返回"案件不存在"错误，记录到审计日志
- X002: 提示"审计功能未激活"，引导用户联系管理员
- X003: 终止搜索，返回"操作超时"提示
- X004: 重定向到登录页面，保存原始请求URL
- X005: 根据配置返回不同级别的响应
- X009: 阻止提交，高亮缺失的证据字段
- X017-X019: 记录违规尝试，返回配置的响应

### 8. 非功能需求设计

1. **性能**：
   - 实现分层缓存(C051,C052)
   - 搜索分页加载(C021)
   - 异步处理耗时操作(C027)

2. **安全**：
   - 全站HTTPS(C053)
   - 输入验证和防注入(C032,C033,C037)
   - 基于角色的访问控制(C048)

3. **可用性**：
   - 响应式设计支持多设备(C067,C072)
   - 符合无障碍标准(C011)
   - 多语言支持(C068)

4. **可靠性**：
   - 审计数据不可更改(C080)
   - 离线模式支持(C030)
   - 数据备份和恢复机制(C029)

classDiagram
    class Case {
        -String caseId
        -String title
        -String description
        -String status
        -DateTime createdAt
        -DateTime updatedAt
        -Object accessControl
        -DateTime createdDate
        -DateTime lastAccessed
        +register()
        +investigate()
        +prosecute()
    }
    class Suspect {
        -String suspectId
        -String name
        -String description
        -String status
        +addToCase()
        +updateStatus()
    }
    class Property {
        -String propertyId
        -String name
        -String description
        -String status
        +markAsEvidence()
        +release()
    }
    class AuditTrail {
        -String auditId
        -String action
        -String userId
        -DateTime timestamp
        -String details
        +logEvent()
        +exportData()
    }
    class UserProfile {
        -String profileId
        -String userId
        -Object uiConfig
        -Object defaults
        -Object uiSettings
        -Object defaultValues
        -String languagePreference
        -String name
        -String role
        -Object uiPreferences
        +savePreferences()
        +resetDefaults()
    }
    class AccessControl {
        -String controlId
        -String userId
        -String groupId
        -Object securityAttributes
        -String securityLevel
        -List assignedGroups
        -Object casePermissions
        -String resourceType
        -String permissionLevel
        -List permissions
        +checkPermission()
        +updateSecurityAttributes()
    }
    class Defect {
        -String defectId
        -String description
        -String status
        -String category
        -DateTime createdAt
        -DateTime reportedDate
        -String priority
        +submit()
        +updateStatus()
    }
    class Configuration {
        -String configId
        -String name
        -String value
        -String description
        -Object settings
        +updateSetting()
        +rollbackChange()
    }

    Case "1" --> "*" Property : contains

    UserProfile "1" --> "1" AccessControl : has
    UserProfile "1" --> "1" Navigation : has
    UserProfile "1" --> "*" Case : assigned
    Defect "1" --> "1" UserProfile : reportedBy

flowchart TD
    %% 案件注册流程
    subgraph 案件注册流程
        A1([开始]) --> A2[公民提交投诉]
        A2 --> A3[警务人员审核]
        A3 --> A4{信息完整?}
        A4 -->|是| A5[生成案件记录]
        A4 -->|否| A6[退回补充信息]
        A5 --> A7[通知相关人员]
        A7 --> A8([结束])
        A6 --> A2
    end
    %% 案件调查流程
    subgraph 案件调查流程
        B1([开始]) --> B2[分配调查人员]
        B2 --> B3[收集证据]
        B3 --> B4[记录调查结果]
        B4 --> B5[更新案件状态]
        B5 --> B6([结束])
    end
    %% 案件起诉流程
    subgraph 案件起诉流程
        C1([开始]) --> C2[准备起诉材料]
        C2 --> C3{材料合规?}
        C3 -->|是| C4[提交法院]
        C3 -->|否| C5[补充材料]
        C4 --> C6[记录法院反馈]
        C6 --> C7[更新案件状态]
        C7 --> C8([结束])
        C5 --> C2
    end
    %% 案件搜索流程
    subgraph 案件搜索流程
        D1([开始]) --> D2[输入搜索条件]
        D2 --> D3[执行搜索]
        D3 --> D4{结果超时?}
        D4 -->|否| D5[过滤结果]
        D4 -->|是| D6[X003: 终止搜索]
        D5 --> D7[显示匹配案件]
        D7 --> D8([结束])
        D6 --> D8
    end
    %% 缺陷跟踪流程
    subgraph 缺陷跟踪流程
        E1([开始]) --> E2[用户提交缺陷]
        E2 --> E3{必填完整?}
        E3 -->|是| E4[帮助台分类]
        E3 -->|否| E5[X011: 显示错误]
        E4 --> E6[分配处理人员]
        E6 --> E7[更新状态]
        E7 --> E8[通知用户]
        E8 --> E9([结束])
        E5 --> E2
    end
    %% 审计检查流程
    subgraph 审计检查流程
        F1([开始]) --> F2[选择审计案件]
        F2 --> F3{审计功能激活?}
        F3 -->|是| F4[生成审计报告]
        F3 -->|否| F5[X002: 提示激活]
        F4 --> F6[导出审计数据]
        F6 --> F7([结束])
        F5 --> F7
    end
    %% 权限检查节点
    A3 --> G1{用户权限?}
    G1 -->|无权| G2[X005: 拒绝访问]
    G1 -->|有权| A4
    B2 --> G3{用户权限?}
    G3 -->|无权| G4[X018: 记录违规]
    G3 -->|有权| B3
    C2 --> G5{用户权限?}
    G5 -->|无权| G6[X019: 记录违规]
    G5 -->|有权| C3
    D3 --> G7{用户权限?}
    G7 -->|无权| G8[X017: 过滤结果]
    G7 -->|有权| D4

content.state_diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    state "案件(Case)" as Case {
        [*] --> 新案件
        新案件 --> 调查中 : 分配调查员
        调查中 --> 起诉中 : 收集足够证据
        调查中 --> 已关闭 : 证据不足
        起诉中 --> 已判决 : 法庭判决
        起诉中 --> 已关闭 : 撤诉
        已判决 --> [*]
        已关闭 --> [*]
    }
    state "嫌疑人(Suspect)" as Suspect {
        [*] --> 未调查
        未调查 --> 调查中 : 关联到案件
        调查中 --> 已起诉 : 证据充分
        调查中 --> 已排除 : 证据不足
        已起诉 --> 已判决 : 法庭判决
        已排除 --> [*]
        已判决 --> [*]
    }
    state "财产/证据(Property)" as Property {
        [*] --> 未登记
        未登记 --> 已登记 : 关联到案件
        已登记 --> 作为证据 : 标记为证据(C044)
        作为证据 --> 已释放 : 法庭释放
        已释放 --> [*]
    }
    state "审计跟踪(AuditTrail)" as AuditTrail {
        [*] --> 未激活
        未激活 --> 激活中 : 管理员启用(C065)
        激活中 --> 记录中 : 系统事件发生
        记录中 --> 导出中 : 审计员请求导出(C078)
        导出中 --> 记录中 : 导出完成
        记录中 --> [*] : 案件关闭(C069)
    }
    state "用户配置(UserProfile)" as UserProfile {
        [*] --> 默认配置
        默认配置 --> 自定义中 : 用户修改界面(F001)
        自定义中 --> 配置保存 : 用户确认
        自定义中 --> 默认配置 : 用户重置
        配置保存 --> [*] : 系统更新(C056)
    }
    state "访问控制(AccessControl)" as AccessControl {
        [*] --> 基础权限

    }
    state "缺陷报告(Defect)" as Defect {

        新建 --> 已提交 : 用户提交(F009)
        已提交 --> 处理中 : 管理员分配
        处理中 --> 已解决 : 修复完成
        处理中 --> 已拒绝 : 无效报告
        已解决 --> [*]
        已拒绝 --> [*]
    }
    state "系统配置(Configuration)" as Configuration {
        [*] --> 默认值
        默认值 --> 修改中 : 管理员调整
        修改中 --> 已保存 : 确认更改
        修改中 --> 默认值 : 取消更改
        已保存 --> [*] : 系统重启
    }
